# ReclaimEmbodiment :148 leaves the Brain quarantine

## Context

`BRAIN_QUARANTINES` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`) holds six entries, all accountable to me. One of them has met its exit, "a diagnosis lands as a fix or a ticket": the fix is #19713, merged via #19715. `connectToApp` had silently bound the oldest same-name session whenever the page's App Worker id was not readable on the first try.

Evidence, `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL` :148 on the fixed fixture: first-try passes in all 3 full-tier runs, the two runs of probe #19716 (never merged) and #19719's run 38422728929. Before its quarantine it had needed the retry in 3 consecutive `dev` runs.

**Narrowed 2026-10-13.** This ticket first took `DockMotionNL`'s rail reveal out too, because it passed both probe runs. In #19719's run 38422728929, on `dev` with the fix, it failed both attempts with its quarantine symptom: "the entry witness must have observed the revealed overlay". The two probe passes were intermittent luck; the fixture fix is not its cause, so it stays quarantined.

## The Problem

A quarantined spec does not run in the Brain-gated tier, so whatever it covers is unguarded until it is un-quarantined. The entry dates from 2026-10-13, and every receipt flags it stale from 2026-10-20.

## The Architectural Reality

Each `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` entry becomes a test-list line through `testListLine`, and the full tier skips it. Removing an entry is the whole un-quarantine. The retry bridge (`BRAIN_RETRY_BRIDGE`, until 2026-10-25) still covers a single intermittent failure, and a spec red on both attempts fails the run.

## The Fix

Delete ReclaimEmbodiment :148's entry. The other five stay, each with its own reason:
- DockMotion's rail reveal: red on both attempts on the fixed fixture.
- FiveBeat dwell previews: still intermittent.
- PopOutSparklines: red on both attempts with its own symptom.
- FilmTour: two entries, a deterministic stop at hop 3.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `BRAIN_QUARANTINES` no longer lists `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL` :148. The other five entries are unchanged.
- [ ] AC-2: The PR's full Brain-gated run executes it, and it passes.
- [ ] AC-3: Post-merge: in the next `dev` runs it is never red on both attempts. If it is, it goes back into quarantine with the new symptom.

## Out of Scope

- The diagnoses of DockMotion's rail reveal, FiveBeat dwell previews and PopOutSparklines.
- FilmTour's two entries.
- The retry bridge.
